rawContent: Whether Sean Penn (why is he being asked?), Matt Damon, & so many men there is almost a reflexive response to discuss a potential flawed accusation, not the thousands of women’s lives empowered to speak of past abuse & thousands more who have likely had abuse prevented by #MeToo

Since start of #MeToo my experience when in the company of different men is after a 2 sentence disclaimer on how MeToo movement is good, there is hyper sensitive concern for false accusations. 

When this happens, it is incumbent to redirect convo back to justice for women

The #MeToo movement is a beautiful thing, mostly cuz it’s future culture-changing effect that will prevent millions of women from being harmed going forward because young boys are watching all this happen, and hearing women speak out in ways I never ever heard growing up.

My biggest learning moment in #MeToo movement was Louis CK. After, I started asking women I knew, and was absolutely clueless to the extent men just whip their shyt out. 

One friend told me it happened to her “at least 15 times”. And here I was thinking it was a freak occurrence

Goal of #MeToo movement is pretty revolutionary, and far past just rape. It’s trying to change the predatory rules of sexual engagement in place since the beginning of time - and many men can’t handle that.

An aspiration like that is gonna get resistance. But I’m here for it.

If I’m more vocal on #MeToo it’s cuz I’ve had 1-wk intensive boot camp of #MarchforBlackWomen; 3-days of Kavanaugh protests hearing survivors; & read over 1K women’s responses to Mysonne. So yeah, I get it more this wk than last. Wiped out tho. Wrote on it https://t.co/qd1Z7rQNxe
